summary: HSPnetPage is a web application page that handles user sessions, localization, and includes various JavaScript and CSS assets for user interaction and appearance. The page manages session timeouts and warnings, integrates Google Analytics, and ensures the UI is properly styled using multiple CSS files.
purpose: To provide a web page that manages user sessions, handles timeouts, and applies consistent styling and functionality across the application using external scripts and stylesheets.

workflows.name: Session Management
steps: Initialize culture based on locale from URL or database.
Set up user session if not already initiated or valid.
Redirect to timed out page if session is invalid.

workflows.name: Session Timeout Handling
steps: Display warnings for sessions nearing expiration.
Reset session or logout upon timeout.

workflows.name: Page Setup
steps: Include global assets such as CSS and JS files.
Integrate Google Analytics if tracking ID is present.
Build left navigation and initialize menus.

business_rules: If no valid locale is found in URL, retrieve it from the database or use a default.
Redirect user if session is not valid.
Warn user when session is close to timing out.
validations: Check if the user session is valid.
calculations: Calculate session timeout rates based on configuration.
Calculate offsets for warning panels if errors exist.
conditions: Display timeout warning if session is close to expiring.
system_behavior: Displays a dialog warning the user when their session is about to expire.
Clears all intervals upon session expiration or reset.
dependencies: JavaScript files for session management and UI behaviors.
Google Analytics for tracking user interactions.
exceptions: Locale is not found in URL or database, use default.
Session becomes invalid during operation, redirect user.
